[Contributors](#contributors) 11. [License](#license) 12. [Support](#support) --- ## About **Pluto** is a production-grade sports betting application built for Discord. It powers a fun, easy to interact with app where members can place virtual bets on real NFL & NBA games (H2H, Prop betting) compete on leaderboards, and climb through progression tiers, all with virtual currency in a risk-free environment. All betting uses in-game currency; no real money involved. Users can claim daily currency rewards to keep the action going. ## Features
### Betting - **Game Betting**: Place bets on NFL & NBA matchups - **Props Betting**: Player prop bets with live markets - **Live Odds**: Real-time odds from sports data APIs - **Fully Autonomous**: Bets lock at kickoff, settle on final — zero manual intervention - **Game Channels**: Dedicated channels auto-created per matchup ### Stats & Competitive - **Betting Stats**: Comprehensive performance tracking - **Leaderboards**: Server-wide rankings & competition - **Progression System**: Earn tiers from Bronze to Diamond - **Predictions**: Community prediction features
